Session.Title: AI Session
Session.Tip: Shows one recent Codex session; tap to switch to all running sessions, tap again for upcoming scheduled tasks, a third time to return

ResetTimer.Title: Reset Timer
ResetTimer.Tip: Counts down to when each plan usage limit resets

NewSession.Title: New Codex Session
NewSession.Tip: Opens a new Codex session in the ChatGPT app

Skill.Title: AI Skill
Skill.Tip: Pastes a selected Codex skill prompt

Dots.Title: ChatGPT Dots
Dots.Tip: Shows the status of your ChatGPT dots; tap to open Dots in the ChatGPT app

NewSession.Title: 新建 Codex 会话
